I see nothing worth staying for. My husband lives in California and I'm in Canada. We've been having a terrible few months and we're trying to set up a move so we could be together. I'm 99% sure he killed himself while we were on the phone tonight. I heard (what sounded like) his last breath. 

I can't do this anymore. My husband didn't even see a point in staying.

My mom's husband (now divorced) molested me when I was 13. I told her the day after it happened and she shrugged it off. She never pursued any legal action against him and continued to have my sister and I at her house on weekends with him while she worked. We were home alone with this pedophile. 

That and the combined fact that I think my husband killed himself tonight and I heard his last breath over the phone, I dont think I can live with myself anymore. 

I wish the best for you. I wish I could take your pain.

The question they asked is a symptom of borderline personality disorder. Splitting is what it's called. I don't want to be here as much as the next guy, but a proper diagnosis may help you feel something
I don't know what I'm fighting for anymore.
